messages.text:
"3D creature collector adventure game with 8 regions to explore, competitive gyms to battle along the way, a fun leveling system, the capture method is battling and capturing creatures with treats you make by crafting and scavenging. There's a character customization option for the trainer(user) male or female. The creatures all have unique original designs and unique strong abilities. They are not small creatures they are typically monster hunter sized creatures but can be cute. The game style during battle would be similar to pokemon where its turn based.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
